phase: Phase 8B — Semantic Embeddings, Metadata Quality Experiments, and TEC Evaluation

protocol_b1_full_catalog_partial_enrichm.description: Full 9,742-movie MovieLens catalog where 11 matched movies receive admin-approved Phase 8A TMDB enriched metadata (overview, overview_vi, title_vi, cast, director, keywords).

protocol_b2_matched_enriched_subset.description: Restricted 11-movie candidate catalog containing ONLY the MovieLens movies with approved Phase 8A enriched metadata.
protocol_b2_matched_enriched_subset.evidence_note: Only 10 of 9742 MovieLens movies (0.10%) have approved Phase 8A enriched metadata (no fabricated metadata permitted). With 10 candidate items and 33 users having both training and relevant test interactions inside the subset, statistical power is insufficient for confirmatory claims (`NOT ENOUGH EVIDENCE`).
